feed.title: Google Cloud: Video Intelligence API
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Video Intelligence API

entry.content: We are deprecating the emotion label response in the API. Going forward, the API will return UNKNOWN for all emotion related labels.
entry.summary: The emotion label response in the API is being deprecated. All emotion-related labels will now return `UNKNOWN`.
entry.title: Deprecated: Emotion label response deprecated
